Privacy information

This website presents the photography and films of Your Wed Stories.

Wedding inquiries

The inquiry form prepares a WhatsApp message in your browser. It does not submit your form details to a studio database. Continuing opens WhatsApp with your details in the link; the studio receives your message when you press Send in WhatsApp. Only include information you are comfortable sharing.

External services

This site requests fonts from Google Fonts. Wedding film players load from YouTube only when you choose Play. These services, our hosting provider and external sites may process connection information such as your IP address under their own policies. WhatsApp and social links take you to external services.

Questions about your information

Contact the studio on WhatsApp at +91 88750 05588 to ask about information you have shared or to request its deletion. Avoid sending sensitive personal information through the inquiry form.
